title: Frappe ERPNext 8.2.5 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 8.2.5 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have an authorization vulnerability in the Manufacturing module. Authenticated users with restricted permissions can manipulate Work Orders belonging to other companies by sending crafted requests to stop, resume, or close them. This occurs because the endpoints check only document-type write access, not specific permissions on each Work Order.
